subject: Re: Portal onboarding — scope, temporary upload access and ownership
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <security@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding — scope & temporary upload access for SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Elena,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the portal onboarding for Greenbridge's SOC 2 / SIG intake. To keep the initial sprint lightweight and avoid gate delays, we'd like to confirm two things before the kickoff call:

1) Ownership & upload pattern
   - Proposal: Redwood will nominate an internal "evidence steward" who uploads signed artifacts and the CSV manifest. We propose Mina Haddad as steward for this engagement.
   - We will need either: a short-lived S3 presign endpoint OR a Vendr upload role with scoped privileges. Which does Greenbridge prefer?

2) Question mapping and scope
   - We'll map our SOC 2 evidence to the SIG/CAIQ fragments you requested and attach a starter manifest. If there are specific QIDs you want excluded from the first pass, flag them now.

3) Ops controls
   - Access: MFA + SSO recommended. If SSO is required, Karthik will own SCIM/SCIM provisioning.
   - Retention: confirm whether Greenbridge wants evidence TTL 90d or permanent in the portal.

Proposed timeline: 2-week evidence sprint beginning Monday, 2025-06-16. Kickoff call Thursday 2025-06-12 at 10:00 AM PT (30 min).

I've attached a starter manifest (redwood_portal_manifest.csv) and a short playbook for our temporary upload process (temp_upload_playbook.txt). Can you confirm the preferred upload method and whether Portal Support should create a temporary upload role for us?

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Partnerships — Security Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_portal_manifest.csv (csv, 3KB), temp_upload_playbook.txt (text, 2KB)

From: Elena Park <security@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Portal Support <portal-support@vendr.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — scope & temporary upload access for SOC 2 / SIG

Camila — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers inline:

- Upload method: we prefer a short-lived Vendr upload role for third-party uploads. S3 presigns are possible but will take longer to approve internally.
- SCIM/SSO: SSO enforced, MFA required. We'll add Karthik as a SCIM provisioned user but need a support ticket to enable our SCIM mapping for the vendor team.
- TTL: please set evidence TTL to 180 days for now; we'll iterate after the audit.

Action items for Redwood: please open a support request with Vendr (cc'd) to create the upload role and provide a scoped list of required permissions. Also attach the CSV manifest with file hashes and a simple mapping file (QID->evidence filename).

I've attached our internal upload guide (greenbridge_portal_instructions.pdf) — it contains the naming conventions and acceptable file types. Portal Support: can you confirm expected RBAC labels for a vendor upload role?

Best,
Elena
Director, Information Security
Greenbridge Health

Attachments: greenbridge_portal_instructions.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — scope & temporary upload access for SOC 2 / SIG

Elena — great, thanks for the clarity. Next steps we will execute this morning:

- I will open the support request with Vendr (ticket created, see link below) to request an "external-uploader" role scoped to: upload:create, manifest:write, metadata:update (no user management).
- Mina will prepare the QID->evidence filename mapping and populate the manifest with SHA256 hashes. Expect the first batch (20 artifacts) by EOD today.
- Karthik will schedule a 15-minute SCIM kickoff with your IdP team to confirm attribute mapping (email, displayName, groups).

Kickoff call still on for Thu 2025-06-12 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite sent.

Attachments: redwood_portal_manifest.csv (updated), temp_upload_playbook.txt

- I've validated hashes for the 12 SOC 2 artifacts we already have signed.
- For the CAIQ fragments, I'll include short context notes in the manifest column "fragment_notes" so portal reviewers can map quickly.
- I'll flag any artifacts that require redaction and request guidance on storing redacted vs. original in portal.
